breakdown.description: The rod is described as free to expand but the constrained-rod thermal stress formula is applied.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the contradictory statement 'A steel rod is free to expand' while applying the constrained formula. The ground truth requires either stating that a free rod has ~zero thermal stress OR changing the problem to specify the rod is fully constrained. The generated text does neither cleanly — it keeps the 'free to expand' language and doesn't acknowledge that a free rod has approximately zero stress, which is the core resolution the ground truth demands.
